# PearlKin

> PearlKin is a skincare app: it starts from a selfie and a short questionnaire, describes visible skin condition for cosmetic purposes, and checks the skincare products you already own for you and the people you live with. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose skin conditions.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://pearlkin.pearlwren.com/): how the skin check, product notes and morning and night routines work, with an illustrated example report
- [Privacy policy](https://pearlkin.pearlwren.com/privacy): what is sent to the AI model, what is stored, how to delete your data
- [Terms](https://pearlkin.pearlwren.com/terms)

## Key facts

- Who it's for: people who want to know whether the skincare on their shelf suits them and their family
- Skin checks from a photo are for ages 13 and up; younger children get product checks only, no face analysis
- Up to 6 people per account
- Platforms: web version in testing; the iPhone app is not out yet; no Android app yet
- Pricing (iPhone app, not out yet): 3-day free trial, then $9.99 a month or $29.99 a year, renewing automatically; cancel in iPhone Settings › your name › Subscriptions
- While testing, every feature of the web version is free
- Contact: hello@pearlwren.com
